releases.name: Dusk Release Checker
releases.summary: Adds a Settings screen that checks the published Dusk release catalog and downloads newer ISO files.
notes: Enter the public HTTPS URL to releases.json in Settings → OS updates.
Check for updates and download a newer Dusk ISO to Chromium’s Downloads folder.
The downloaded ISO must still be booted manually; live-system updates are not installed automatically.

releases.name: Dusk Voice Controls
releases.summary: A Dusk live ISO with push-to-talk voice commands for opening apps and powering off the TV.
notes: Press Talk to Dusk and say commands such as “open YouTube” or “power off the TV.”
Voice recognition starts only after you press the microphone button and requires internet access.
